identificationModule.briefTitle: A Trial Assessing LAS34273 in Moderate to Severe Stable Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Trial Assessing Efficacy and Safety of LAS34273 in Moderate to Severe Stable Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) Patients

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of LAS 34273 compared to placebo in patients with moderate to severe COPD during one year of treatment.

armGroups.label: Aclidinium 200 μg once-daily
armGroups.description: Aclidinium bromide 200 μg once-daily by inhalation

interventions.name: Aclidinium bromide
interventions.description: Aclidinium bromide 200 μg once-daily via inhalation via the Eklira Genuair® inhaler: 1 puff in the morning for 52 weeks

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo once-daily via inhalation: 1 puff in the morning for 52 weeks

primaryOutcomes.measure: Trough FEV1 (L) at 28 Weeks on Treatment
primaryOutcomes.description: Trough FEV1 (mean of two highest FEV1 values assessed at 23 and 24 hours after inhalation) at 28 weeks

primaryOutcomes.measure: Trough Forced Expiratory Volume in the First Second (FEV1) (L) at 12 Weeks on Treatment
primaryOutcomes.description: Trough FEV1 (mean of two highest FEV1 values assessed at 23 and 24 hours after inhalation) at 12 weeks

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to First Moderate or Severe COPD Exacerbation at 52 Weeks on Treatment
secondaryOutcomes.description:
Time to first moderate or severe exacerbation:

Increase of COPD symptoms during at least 2 consecutive days, treated with antibiotics and/or systemic corticosteroids or an increase in dose of systemic corticosteroids, or leading to hospitalisation.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Patients Who Achieved at Least a 4-unit Decrease From Baseline in the SGRQ Total Score at 52 Weeks on Treatment
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of patients who achieved a clinically relevant improvement in health-related quality of life at 52 weeks, as measured by at least a 4-unit decrease from baseline in St George's Respiratory Questionnaire (SGRQ) total score

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males and females aged ≥ 40 years with a clinical diagnosis of moderate to severe stable COPD

Exclusion Criteria:

* History or current diagnosis of asthma, recent respiratory tract infection or acute COPD exacerbation, life expectancy of less than 1 year, known symptomatic prostatic hypertrophy, bladder neck obstruction or narrow-angle glaucoma

references.citation: Spata E, Jauhiainen A, Da Silva CA. Impact of season and geography on COPDCompEx: a composite endpoint for COPD trials. Respir Med Res. 2026 Jul 12;90:101305. doi: 10.1016/j.resmer.2026.101305. Online ahead of print.

Jones PW, Rennard SI, Agusti A, Chanez P, Magnussen H, Fabbri L, Donohue JF, Bateman ED, Gross NJ, Lamarca R, Caracta C, Gil EG. Efficacy and safety of once-daily aclidinium in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Respir Res. 2011 Apr 26;12(1):55. doi: 10.1186/1465-9921-12-55.

participantFlowModule.preAssignmentDetails: Following a screening visit, patients entered a 14-day run-in period during which they used inhaled salbutamol administered via a pressurised metered dose inhaler (pMDI) as rescue medication on an "as needed" basis. The 14-day run-in period was used to assess the stability of each patient's disease and baseline characteristics.
participantFlowModule.recruitmentDetails: The study was conducted in 132 sites: 1 in Andorra, 5 in Austria, 4 in Belgium, 10 in Bulgaria, 8 in the Czech Republic, 3 in Denmark, 9 in France, 10 in Germany, 8 in Hungary, 6 in Italy, 4 in Netherlands, 9 in Poland, 9 in Romania, 25 in Russia, 8 in Spain, 13 in the UK. First patient was screened in Aug 2006 and last patient visit was May 2008.
